desc:
🥚 Welcome to Ride An Egg!

🎃 HALLOWEEN UPDATE!
🏰 Explore Halloween Hollow
👻 Collect 8 new spooky pets
🏃 Train faster with the new Haunted Treadmill!

How to Play:
🥚 Steal a massive egg from its guardian
🎢 Ride it downhill and smash through everything in your way
🦖 Outrun the guardian before it catches you
🐣 Hatch eggs in your pen to collect rare pets
💰 Earn money from your pets
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and base
🌋 Unlock 9 zones with bigger eggs, from the Farm to the Moon Base
✨ Discover Golden, Rainbow and Cosmic mutations!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet players, & Console
